structure: Part 12 (Additional details and contact) mined all 15 traces its read names: 9 from additional-details.fit.spec.js (rendering: 98ff4 :43, 7551a :74, be2d3 :83; unweaned commodity gate: a90fd :101, 01f6b :112; validation: db17f :139, c0bef :169; persistence and accessibility: 95b78 :208, 42575 :227) and 6 from contact.fit.spec.js (3ac7c :43, d776d :60, 6b476 :66, 6aea6 :89, c6038 :117, a6bde :125). Both spec files were read in full for test titles and assertions. Method note: the trace CLI run through `tim distil trace` refused every zip (TraceVersionError: the traces were recorded by a newer Playwright than the viewer tim installs), so each zip, already unzipped into this part's working folder by an earlier run, was read directly: the action timeline from the `before` events of 1-trace.trace, the rendered DOM from the largest frame-snapshot for a call (rendered to markup with a jq filter), the page title and back link from the same snapshot, the form posts and redirects from 1-trace.network, and the axe result from the `after` event of the axe finishRun call. Action ids below are those callIds. Pages, in journey order: (1) Additional details, /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/additional-details, caption 'Commodity details', h1 'Additional details', task row 'Additional details' under '2. Description of the goods' on the Overview hub. Two radio questions under one h1: 'What are the animals certified for?' (16 options, always asked) and 'Does the consignment contain any unweaned animals?' (Yes/No, asked of cattle (Bos taurus) and not of a horses-only (Equus caballus) consignment). Every trace reached it by direct navigation after origin, commodity selection and commodity details. (2) Contact address for consignment, /live-animals/notifications/{ref}/consignment/contact/select, single-question page whose legend is the h1, task row 'Contact address for this consignment' under '6. Contact address'. One radio question listing 13 address-book contacts, each with its address as a radio hint; once a contact is saved, a 'Current contact address' summary card with an 'Edit details' link appears. Every contact trace reached it by direct navigation after only the origin page. Both pages post back to themselves (POST, 302 to the Overview hub on success, 400 with an error summary on an invalid value), carry a hidden concurrencyToken, and offer 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview'. Both are entirely govuk-frontend components apart from the app-journey-strip (Draft tag and notification reference). Not reached by any trace in this part: a blank submission on either page, the 'Yes' unweaned answer, 'Save and return to overview', 'Cancel and return to overview', the contact 'Edit details' page, and any server-side call to the certification-purposes or address-book services; each is recorded as a gap.
